AccessKeyIn.description: A replacement access key, whole: a rotated key or a new SSO session changes every part.
AccessKeyIn.title: AccessKeyIn

CommandOut.description: A CloudFox loot command shown on this resource (ADR-0038). Argus never runs it.
CommandOut.title: CommandOut

ConnectionPatch.description:
What Edit connection changes. `auth_method` other than the connection's own switches its
sign-in method: it must come with that method's whole set (`access_key`, or `assume_role`
with a `role_arn`), and the old method's credentials are deleted. The account never changes.
ConnectionPatch.title: ConnectionPatch

CoverageOut.description:
Whether the scanner scans the resource, for one scan type. `active` is the verdict; the
status code and reason are the scanner's own words (AWS Inspector: ACTIVE or INACTIVE, with
a reason such as UNMANAGED_EC2_INSTANCE).
CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut

FindingDetail.description:
One finding with what the tool says about it: about the check, the same for each of its
findings (`detail`, about this resource, is in the list too).
FindingDetail.title: FindingDetail

FindingFilterQuery.description:
The Findings list's filters: its query parameters, and a report's. A list parameter
repeats (`severity=high&severity=critical`) and matches any of its values; absent, it does
not filter.
FindingFilterQuery.title: FindingFilterQuery

FindingGroupOut.description: One check of the findings matching the filters (the Findings list by check).
FindingGroupOut.title: FindingGroupOut

InventoryWeek.description:
One ISO week (`week` is its Monday). Null counts: before the inventory was first counted.
`baseline`: how many accounts had their first scan that week; their resources are their
starting inventory, not counted as added.
InventoryWeek.title: InventoryWeek

MisconfigurationSummary.description:
Investigate → Misconfigurations → Summary, from stored counts only. Each account counts
as of its latest scan, however old; disabled accounts are left out, as on the Overview.
Null: no Prowler or CloudFox scan yet, never 0.
MisconfigurationSummary.title: MisconfigurationSummary

MonthRow.description:
One month of a month-over-month table (metrics.series.month_table): each severity's open
count at the month's end, the total, and the change from the column before. Null values: no
data that month, never 0. Null changes: no column before to compare with.
MonthRow.title: MonthRow

ProwlerOptions.description:
What Collection settings may skip: the pinned Prowler's AWS services and checks. A
check's service is the first word of its id.
ProwlerOptions.title: ProwlerOptions

RawStorageSettings.description:
Where AWS runs keep their raw output: an S3 bucket the operator owns, encrypted by its
default SSE-KMS key, with a folder per tool. Demo connections always use the local volume.
While no bucket is set, AWS runs cannot start: raw output of a real account never lands
on the unencrypted local volume (SA-8).
RawStorageSettings.title: RawStorageSettings

RemediationCode.description: Remediation a human may apply, as the tool wrote it. Argus never runs it.
RemediationCode.title: RemediationCode

ResourcesSummary.description:
Investigate → Resources → Summary, from stored counts only. Each account counts as of its
latest Steampipe load, however old; disabled accounts are left out, as on the Overview.
Null: no Steampipe scan yet, never 0.
ResourcesSummary.title: ResourcesSummary

ResourcesSummaryAssets.description: The inventory's assets (the list filter `assets=1`): the types the Overview counts.
ResourcesSummaryAssets.title: ResourcesSummaryAssets

ResourcesSummaryAtRisk.description:
Distinct current assets at risk, each as of its tools' latest count. Null: no scan by
those tools yet (Prowler or CloudFox; the vulnerabilities tool), never 0.
ResourcesSummaryAtRisk.title: ResourcesSummaryAtRisk

RiskRow.description:
One resource at risk. The facts are what made its combinations, each one a link on the
screen to the list it comes from.
RiskRow.title: RiskRow

RiskSummary.description:
The tiles: resources at risk on the scope's latest count, by tier and by combination.
`computed` false (and every count null): Risk was never computed for the scope.
RiskSummary.title: RiskSummary

RoleIn.description:
A change to an assume-role connection: a role in the same account, a new ExternalId, or
the ExternalId removed. What is left out keeps its stored value; the ExternalId is never
returned.
RoleIn.title: RoleIn

RunTrigger.title: RunTrigger

SettingsOut.description:
An admin's settings. Collection is apart (GET /settings/collection): Schedules reads it at
every role, and this holds the raw output bucket and the platform's access key id.
SettingsOut.title: SettingsOut

SignInOut.description: How people sign in (ADR-0048), read-only: it is set in the deployment, never here.
SignInOut.title: SignInOut

SummaryAge.description:
Open findings by how long ago they were first seen, counted from today. The two dates
are the list's first-seen filter that reproduces the column (null: no bound).
SummaryAge.title: SummaryAge

SummaryItem.description:
One bar of a breakdown: a category, service or region (the list filter of the same name),
or a reach. An empty value is the findings with none (no category, no service).
SummaryItem.title: SummaryItem

SummaryOpen.description:
Open misconfigurations: open or reopened, status FAIL, not muted, Prowler and CloudFox
(the list filters `state=open&status=FAIL&muted=hide`).
SummaryOpen.title: SummaryOpen

SummaryWeek.description: One ISO week (`week` is its Monday). Null counts: before the summary was first counted.
SummaryWeek.title: SummaryWeek

ToolPrefixes.description: Each tool's folder in the bucket. The defaults are the design's layout, raw/<tool>.
ToolPrefixes.title: ToolPrefixes

ToolScans.description:
The newest day each tool's ingested run covers for the resource's connection; null
when the tool never scanned it ("Not covered" rather than "no findings").
ToolScans.title: ToolScans

VulnerabilitiesSummary.description:
Investigate → Vulnerabilities → Summary, from stored counts only. Each account counts as
of its latest vulnerabilities scan, however old; disabled accounts are left out, as on the
Overview. Null: no vulnerabilities scan yet, never 0.
VulnerabilitiesSummary.title: VulnerabilitiesSummary

VulnerabilitiesSummaryOpen.description:
Open vulnerabilities: open or reopened, not suppressed in the scanner (the list filters
`state=open&muted=hide`).
VulnerabilitiesSummaryOpen.title: VulnerabilitiesSummaryOpen

VulnerabilityFilterQuery.description:
The Vulnerabilities list's filters: its query parameters, and a report's. A list
parameter repeats and matches any of its values; absent, it does not filter.
VulnerabilityFilterQuery.title: VulnerabilityFilterQuery

VulnerabilityFixItem.description:
Open vulnerabilities by whether a fix exists: `available` and `none` are the list's fix
filter; `unknown` (the scanner does not say) has none.
VulnerabilityFixItem.title: VulnerabilityFixItem

VulnerabilityMonths.description:
Open vulnerabilities (not suppressed in the scanner) at each of the last six calendar
months' ends, oldest first: each account's latest count on or before the month end, however
old. `data_through`: the newest count shown.
VulnerabilityMonths.title: VulnerabilityMonths

VulnerabilityOut.description:
What a vulnerability finding adds (ADR-0042): the vulnerable package and its fix. A code
vulnerability has no CVE and no package.
VulnerabilityOut.title: VulnerabilityOut

VulnerabilitySection.description: The resource's vulnerabilities, as of the connection's last vulnerabilities run.
VulnerabilitySection.title: VulnerabilitySection

VulnerabilitySummary.description: A resource's open CVEs (ADR-0042), suppressed ones left out.
VulnerabilitySummary.title: VulnerabilitySummary

put.description: The signed-in user's own password. Their other sessions end; this one stays.

post.description:
The IdP's answer. No CSRF header can come with a cross-site POST: the signed state cookie
and the IdP's signature are what bind it (ADR-0048, section 4).

get.description: Argus's SP metadata, for the IdP's set-up. It holds no secret.

Every framework with results in the last six months: score, change, requirement counts
and a weekly trend, for one connection or all (0). `provider` repeats and matches the
framework's own provider.

One framework for one connection or all (0): its score, the history for the range, and
the six month-ends.

Each connection's month-end score for the framework, lowest latest score first. No
average row: the overall average across accounts was set aside (2026-10-07).

The framework's requirements on its latest day for the connection (or all, 0), by
section and requirement id.

schema.title: Response List Connections Api V1 Connections Get

get.description: The kinds the Add connection dialog may offer: no Demo on Kubernetes (ADR-0039).

schema.title: Response Connection Kinds Api V1 Connections Kinds Get

post.description:
Queues a test of an AWS connection (a Demo connection has nothing to test: 422). Asking
while one is open returns the open one.

get.description: The context bar: which accounts exist, and each tool's last run.
The options of the Misconfigurations filters that come from the data.

The Misconfigurations list by check, with the list's filters: one row per tool and check
id, worst severity first, then the checks with the most findings.

The Misconfigurations summary for all connections (0) or one: stored counts written by
ingest, so it never counts findings at request time.

One finding, whatever its state, with what the tool says about it: what a finding's own
link opens, and the list's details row. Its scan time is `last_seen`.
Liveness: the process answers. No database call.
Readiness: the database answers.
Newest first: the user's own reports, or everyone's for an Admin.

post.description:
Queues a report over the list's filters. Refused (422, with a sentence) where this
install can't keep a report now, when no account matches, when an account is a real AWS
connection on a local store, or when the user has too many reports being built.

get.description:
The report's file, as an attachment. The key comes from the row only, and must have a
report key's shape. The file is served only when it is the one the build recorded (its size,
and on S3 its SHA-256), checked before the first byte. The database connection is released
before the file streams, so a slow download never holds a slot of the API's capped pool.

200.description: The report's file, as its format says.

get.description:
The options of the Resources filters that come from the data, for these connections (all
when none is given).

The Resources summary for all connections (0) or one: stored counts written by ingest,
so it never counts resources or findings at request time.

schema.title: Response List Combinations Api V1 Risk Combinations Get

post.description:
Cancels a run request, never to be retried. A queued one (a waiting retry, a staggered
scheduled run, a Run now) is cancelled at once. A running one is asked to stop: its tool is
killed within about half a minute and the run is recorded as cancelled; if its results are
already loading, it finishes instead. 404 when the request is neither queued nor running, or
was already asked to stop.

get.description: Schedules by name; `q` keeps those whose name contains it, in any case.

post.description: Plain-language preview and next runs, before saving.

Queues a test of the platform identity: sign in, then write a marker to each tool's
folder of the raw output bucket.

Another user's password: they choose their own at the next sign-in. Your own is changed
with PUT /auth/password, which needs the current one.

get.description: One page of CVE findings; each item carries its `vulnerability`.
The options of the Vulnerabilities filters that come from the data.

The Vulnerabilities list by CVE, with the list's filters: one row per CVE, worst
severity first, then the CVEs with the most findings.

The Vulnerabilities summary for all connections (0) or one: stored counts written by
ingest, so it never counts findings at request time.
